hypotheses.persona: Construction/field worker with a regular 9-5 schedule
hypotheses.rationale: Early morning departure pattern consistent (05:09 on Day 0, 04:55 on Day 1, 05:12 on Day 2) with work badge, thermos, keys, laptop and phone. Return pattern also consistent (18:22 on Day 0, 18:24 on Day 1, 18:33 on Day 2). Hi-vis vest observation strongly supports field work hypothesis. Midday returns on all three days suggest lunch break at home. Weekend behavior (Days 5-6) shows no early departures, consistent with a worker who has weekends off.
Day 3 and Day 4 show departure at 13:23 and 13:29 respectively, which is unusual compared to previous early morning departures. This could indicate a different shift schedule or meeting pattern.

hypotheses.rationale: Laptop being taken to work and returned midday suggests occasional office visits, but early departure pattern with work badge and hi-vis vest points more strongly to field work.
